name: 职业
intro: 职业 = 力量源 + 训练方式 + 社会身份。西幻职业不是门派：同一个学院出法师，同一个骑士团可以有不同种族。超凡强度用灵魂成色衡量，武艺手艺另计熟练度；各职业怎么升阶各不相同（见 systems.md 第 3 节），头衔由各自的组织授予。人物图为原型演示形体，不是剧中角色。

subgroups.name: 武人
subgroups.intro: 力量源主要是勇武（英雄之光），靠锤炼与誓言。

entries.name: 战士
entries.summary: 职业军人与雇佣兵：精通各种兵器与盔甲，靠经验与体魄取胜，是数量最多的武力阶层。

xianxia.concept: 武修 / 散修武者（参照）
xianxia.note: 西方战士没有内功体系，强在装备、战术和身经百战。

entries.cost: 依赖装备与体力，衰老后迅速下滑。
entries.counter: 魔法远程、毒、恐惧。
entries.visual: 实战磨损的锁子甲与板甲拼件、皮革、斗篷，兵器各异。

details.成长: 实战 → 名声 → 被骑士收为侍从或成为佣兵团长

image.brief: A battle-hardened adult mercenary man-at-arms in practical mismatched armor: a dented steel breastplate over chainmail, leather bracers, a weathered wool cloak, a longsword at the hip and a scarred round wooden shield on the back, short-cropped hair, a healed scar across the jaw, confident relaxed stance.

entries.name: 骑士
entries.summary: 受封的武人贵族：以誓言、荣誉和骑乘冲锋为核心，效忠领主或骑士团。

xianxia.concept: 剑宗弟子 / 世家护法（参照）
xianxia.note: 骑士的力量与「誓言」绑定，背誓会失去英雄之光（见失恩）。

entries.cost: 誓言约束行为；荣誉受损即失去身份。
entries.counter: 长枪阵、泥沼地形、利用其荣誉感设局。
entries.visual: 整套板甲、纹章罩袍、骑枪与长剑、战马。

details.成长: 侍童 → 侍从 → 授剑礼 → 立功受封土地

references.work: 中世纪骑士制度 / 亚瑟王传说

image.brief: A noble adult knight in a full suit of polished steel plate armor, helmet held under one arm revealing a determined face, a heraldic surcoat in deep blue with an original simple tower-and-oak-leaf emblem, a longsword sheathed at the hip, a kite shield resting against the leg, a long riding cloak.

entries.name: 狂战士
entries.summary: 以狂怒入战的部落战士：战狂中不知疼痛、力大无穷，但敌我不分。

xianxia.concept: 炼体 / 狂化秘术（参照）
xianxia.note: 源自北欧狂战士，战狂是「被附体般」的状态，事后极度虚弱。

entries.cost: 战狂后虚脱、可能误伤同伴，难以停下。
entries.counter: 冷静的计谋、长期消耗、远程。
entries.visual: 兽皮、裸露的伤疤与战纹、巨斧，战狂时眼睛充血。

details.成长: 部落成人礼 → 首次战狂 → 兽灵认可

image.brief: A massive adult tribal berserker with a bear pelt worn over the shoulders with the bear's head as a hood, bare scarred arms painted with blue-black war stripes, braided beard, a huge two-handed bearded axe, fur boots and leather wraps, wild bloodshot eyes and a fierce snarl.

entries.name: 游侠
entries.summary: 边境与荒野的守护者：追踪、弓术、野外生存，常与一只动物伙伴同行。

xianxia.concept: 猎户出身的散修 / 御兽者（参照）

entries.cost: 远离城市与补给；伙伴兽死去会重创精神。
entries.counter: 近身、城市、封闭空间。
entries.visual: 绿褐色兜帽斗篷、长弓、箭袋、皮甲，身边有狼或鹰。

details.成长: 边境巡守 → 与兽伙伴缔结 → 成为一片土地的守望者

references.work: 中世纪林务官与边境巡守

image.brief: A lean adult wilderness ranger in a hooded cloak of mottled green and brown wool, layered leather armor, a tall yew longbow in hand and a quiver of grey-fletched arrows, a hunting knife and a coil of rope at the belt, mud-stained boots, a large grey wolf companion sitting at their side.

entries.name: 盗贼
entries.summary: 开锁、潜行、扒窃、情报：靠技巧与胆量吃饭的城市暗面职业。

xianxia.concept: 神偷 / 情报组织成员（参照）

entries.cost: 被抓即重刑；信任难建立。
entries.counter: 陷阱、守卫犬、真言魔法。
entries.visual: 深色紧身衣物、多口袋皮带、开锁工具、短匕。

details.力量源: 技艺（低阶可有少量幻术）

image.brief: A nimble adult city thief in close-fitting dark charcoal clothes and a short hooded capelet, a leather belt with many small pouches and a roll of lockpicks, two slim daggers, soft-soled boots, a half-mask pulled down around the neck, a sly confident smile, a stolen gold ring in one hand.

entries.name: 刺客
entries.summary: 以杀人为业的精英：毒药、伪装、一击必杀，多隶属秘密兄弟会。

xianxia.concept: 杀手组织 / 暗殿（参照）

entries.cost: 兄弟会的规矩比命重；退出几乎不可能。
entries.counter: 护身符、试毒者、提前得知契约。
entries.visual: 黑灰色贴身装束、面罩、藏刃、毒瓶。

references.note: 雇佣刺客与秘密兄弟会

image.brief: An adult assassin in fitted layered black and ash-grey clothing with a deep hood and a cloth mask covering the lower face, cold sharp eyes visible, a slim curved blade held low and reversed, hidden throwing knives on a chest strap, a small vial of green poison at the belt.

subgroups.name: 信仰者
subgroups.intro: 力量源是圣光。头衔由教会授予，但圣光只认信念。

entries.name: 牧师
entries.summary: 教会的神职者：治愈、祝福、驱邪、主持圣礼，也是战场上的随军医者。

xianxia.concept: 佛门 / 道观中的医修与祝由（参照）

entries.cost: 信念动摇即失效；受教会纪律约束。
entries.counter: 亵渎之地、毒与诅咒、信仰危机。
entries.visual: 白色与金色法衣、圣徽、香炉或权杖。

image.brief: A serene adult priestess in layered white linen vestments with gold-embroidered borders and a plain long white scarf, a gold pendant shaped as a flat engraved sun disc: a solid round disc with exactly seven short triangular rays touching its rim, evenly spaced, and a thin closed inner ring (seven rays, never eight; straight edges, not wavy, not bars) on a chain at her chest, holding a slender silver staff topped with the same seven-rayed sun disc, a small leather satchel of bandages and herbs, gentle but resolute expression.

entries.name: 圣武士
entries.summary: 立下神圣誓言的战士：剑与圣光兼修，能治愈、能惩戒邪物，誓言就是力量的来源。

xianxia.concept: 正道剑修 / 护法金刚（参照）
xianxia.note: 力量完全依赖誓言是否被遵守；背誓即失恩（FL04）。

entries.cost: 誓言约束极严；失恩是职业生涯的终点或转折。
entries.counter: 让其誓言自相矛盾的两难局面。
entries.visual: 白银板甲、金色圣徽、披风，武器在战斗中燃起金光。

details.誓言: 守护、正义、复仇等誓言类型由采用剧选择
details.成长: 立誓 → 守誓试炼 → 圣迹认可

image.brief: An imposing adult holy warrior in polished silver-white plate armor with gold trim, a white tabard with an original golden emblem of a seven-rayed sun disc (a plain circle with seven equal short wedge-shaped rays and a thin inner ring), a long white cloak, a heavy longsword planted point-down before them with both hands on the pommel, a faint warm golden glow around the shoulders, steadfast expression.

entries.name: 审判官
entries.summary: 教会的执法者：追捕异端、女巫、恶魔崇拜者，也负责驱魔。立场常在正义与狂热之间。

xianxia.concept: 正道执法堂 / 斩妖除魔者（参照）

entries.cost: 常被权力与狂热腐蚀；仇家遍地。
entries.counter: 证据、民意、被冤者的真相。
entries.visual: 黑色宽檐帽或兜帽、长大衣、银十字弩/手弩、圣水瓶、锁链。

image.brief: A grim adult witch hunter in a long black leather greatcoat over a dark vest, a wide-brimmed black hat, a plain round silver medallion with no engraving hanging on the chest, a compact crossbow in one hand, bandoliers holding small glass vials of holy water, a coiled iron chain hanging from the belt, a stern unforgiving gaze.

subgroups.name: 奥术与学问
subgroups.intro: 力量源是奥术或工艺，靠学习与研究。

entries.name: 法师
entries.summary: 学院出身的学者型施法者：读书、研究、主修一个学派，靠知识累积力量。

xianxia.concept: 法修 / 宗门弟子（参照）
xianxia.note: 西方法师的核心资产是「法术书」与知识，被夺书比被夺修为更致命。

entries.cost: 身体脆弱；施法需准备与咒文；知识被垄断在学院手里。
entries.counter: 近身、打断咒文、夺走法术书。
entries.visual: 长袍、法杖或魔杖、厚重法术书、墨渍手指。

details.成长: 学徒 → 杰作 → 大师

references.note: 约翰·迪伊等学者型术士

image.brief: A scholarly adult wizard in layered deep violet and charcoal wool robes with silver-embroidered cuffs, a heavy leather-bound spellbook chained to the belt, holding a tall carved staff topped with a violet crystal, ink-stained fingers, reading spectacles pushed up on the head, a satchel of scrolls, thoughtful expression.

entries.name: 战斗法师
entries.summary: 剑与法术同修：在近战中瞬发短咒，或把法术附在剑上。

xianxia.concept: 法剑双修（参照）

entries.cost: 两头都难登顶；同时维持武艺与学问。
entries.counter: 纯法师远程、纯战士压制。
entries.visual: 轻甲加法袍、单手剑上有符文、空手泛着法光。

image.brief: An agile adult battlemage in a fitted half-plate cuirass worn over a long split violet robe, an arming sword with faint glowing blue engraved lines along the blade in one hand, the other hand crackling with a small sphere of blue arcane light, a short spellbook in a holster on the thigh, poised mid-ready stance.

entries.name: 召唤师
entries.summary: 以法阵和契约召唤外界生物为自己作战或服务；强弱取决于召唤物和控制力。

xianxia.concept: 御兽 / 驱使鬼神（参照）

entries.cost: 失控的召唤物会反噬；契约生物会讨价还价。
entries.counter: 斩断召唤链接、破坏法阵、攻击本体。
entries.visual: 随身粉笔与盐、法阵卷轴、钥匙串（象征打开门）。

references.work: 所罗门之钥等魔法书传统
references.note: 以法阵召唤与约束灵体

image.brief: An adult summoner in long dark indigo robes with deep sleeves, a ring of many old iron keys at the belt, a stick of white chalk and a pouch of salt, a rolled parchment of geometric circle diagrams under one arm, kneeling beside a freshly drawn chalk circle on a floor made of two concentric rings, a seven-sided heptagon and radiating straight lines (no stars, no triangles), a faint indigo glow rising from the circle.

entries.name: 炼金术士
entries.summary: 以蒸馏、调和、嬗变制作药剂、毒药、炸药与奇物；不靠天赋，靠配方和实验。

xianxia.concept: 丹师 / 炼丹（参照）
xianxia.note: 西方炼金术与中国外丹是真实的历史平行，都追求长生与点金。差异：西方炼金士更像实验室学者，炼成品多是液体药剂。

entries.cost: 实验事故、中毒、教会对「渎神」的怀疑。
entries.counter: 配方被盗、关键原料断供。
entries.visual: 皮围裙、护目镜、蒸馏器、玻璃瓶与腰包。

details.力量源: 工艺（不需觉醒也能做低阶）

references.note: 帕拉塞尔苏斯与医药炼金

image.brief: An eccentric adult alchemist in a stained leather apron over rolled-up shirtsleeves, brass goggles pushed up on the forehead, a bandolier of small colored glass vials across the chest, holding up a round flask of glowing green liquid to inspect it, faint chemical burns on the fingers, curious intense expression.

entries.name: 符文匠
entries.summary: 把力量刻进金属与石头：锻造符文武器、守护石、护身符。几乎不直接施法。

xianxia.concept: 炼器师 / 符师 / 阵法师（参照）

entries.cost: 极慢；一件作品可能要数年；行规森严。
entries.counter: 磨损符文、熔毁作品。
entries.visual: 铁匠皮围裙、刻刀与锤、发光的刻痕。

references.work: 北欧传统 / 战锤奇幻
references.note: 符文与只刻符不施法的匠人

image.brief: A broad-shouldered adult runesmith in a heavy scorched leather smith's apron over a wool tunic, thick forearms, braided hair tied back, holding a fine steel engraving chisel in one hand and a small hammer in the other, a half-finished axe head with glowing molten-gold carved angular marks resting on a portable anvil beside them.

entries.name: 先知
entries.summary: 看见未来与远方的人：为王室与神庙服务，或在乡野流浪；预言总是模糊而准确。

xianxia.concept: 卜算子 / 天机阁（参照）

entries.cost: 看到的未来无法完全改变；常失明或疯癫；被权力者囚禁利用。
entries.counter: 遮蔽天机之物、命运之外的人。
entries.visual: 蒙眼布或乳白色眼睛、骨与水晶、烟与香。

details.力量源: 奥术（预言系）或神圣（神谕）

image.brief: An adult seer with a strip of pale linen tied over the eyes as a blindfold, long loose hair woven with tiny bone beads, layered pale grey robes, holding a smooth clear crystal sphere cupped in both hands, a thin trail of incense smoke curling around them, calm otherworldly expression.

entries.name: 吟游诗人
entries.summary: 以歌、诗与故事施展魔力：鼓舞、魅惑、记忆与情报。传颂谁，谁就能成为传奇。

xianxia.concept: 乐修（参照）
xianxia.note: 西方吟游诗人还承担「传颂功业」的作用——英雄的名声靠他们传播，名声本身有力量（见功业 GR07）。

entries.cost: 得罪权贵；歌谣会被篡改。
entries.counter: 噪音、沉默魔法、毁掉其名声。
entries.visual: 鲁特琴或竖琴、鲜艳斗篷、羽毛帽。

references.work: 凯尔特吟游者 / 北欧 skald
references.note: 诗人的社会地位与诅咒之歌

image.brief: A charismatic adult bard in a dashing slashed doublet of burgundy and gold, a short travel cape thrown over one shoulder, a feathered cap, playing a pear-shaped wooden lute with inlaid soundhole, a dagger at the belt and a small drum hanging at the hip, mid-song with a roguish grin.

subgroups.name: 自然与元素
subgroups.intro: 力量源是自然或元素，靠被接纳与沟通。

entries.name: 德鲁伊
entries.summary: 古老的自然祭司：守护圣林与土地，能变形、驭兽、控制植物与天气，主持季节仪式。

xianxia.concept: 隐世宗门 / 木系修士 / 妖修亲近者（参照）

entries.cost: 与土地绑定，离开太远会衰弱；变形太久会野化。
entries.counter: 焚林、冷铁、城市化。
entries.visual: 白色或绿色长袍、橡木杖、槲寄生、金镰、兽骨饰物。

image.brief: A weathered adult druid in a long undyed white wool robe with a moss-green mantle, a crown of oak leaves and mistletoe, a gnarled oak staff wrapped with ivy, a small golden crescent sickle hanging from a rope belt, necklaces of carved bone and acorns, bare feet on the ground, wise calm expression.

entries.name: 元素术士
entries.summary: 与元素精灵谈判的自然哲人：按帕拉塞尔苏斯的说法，火有火蜥蜴、水有水妖、风有风精、土有地灵；元素术士以供奉、契约和真名驱使它们。也兼修赛兹的通灵。

xianxia.concept: 五行术士（参照）

entries.cost: 元素精灵会要价；契约失效时元素反噬。
entries.counter: 驱灵、真名被夺、元素真空。
entries.visual: 学者式长外套上沾着灰烬与水渍，腰间挂四只装元素样本的小瓶（火、水、土、风），手持铜质测风器。

image.brief: An adult natural philosopher elementalist in a long weathered scholar's coat of dark green wool over a leather waistcoat, singed cuffs and water-stained hem, four small stoppered glass vials on the belt holding a tiny live flame, swirling water, a pinch of glowing soil and a captured wisp of moving air, holding a brass instrument like an astrolabe, a small salamander made of flame curled on the shoulder, curious and composed expression.

entries.name: 术士
entries.summary: 血里带着力量的天生施法者：不读书，靠本能与情绪施法，强大但难以控制。

xianxia.concept: 天生神体 / 血脉觉醒者（参照）
xianxia.note: 与法师对立：法师靠学，术士靠生。常被学院视为危险分子。

entries.cost: 情绪失控即暴走；被猎杀血脉者追捕。
entries.counter: 冷静、封印纹身、天敌材料。
entries.visual: 无需法杖，皮肤下血管或纹路发光，瞳孔异色。

details.天赋: 龙血、天裔、魔裔、妖精血等

references.note: 梅林的梦魔出身——天生异能

image.brief: A striking adult sorceress in a fitted crimson and black gown with a high collar and a travel cloak, no staff or book, faint glowing ember-red lines visible under the skin of her arms and neck like veins of fire, one eye amber and one eye dark, a small flame flickering in her open palm, intense and slightly dangerous expression.

entries.name: 猎魔人
entries.summary: 以猎杀怪物为业的人：熟知民间克制之法（银、冷铁、盐、圣水、花楸），按委托清除吸血鬼、狼人、亡灵与妖精作祟。不靠变异，靠知识、装备与胆量；许多人是半吸血鬼或胎膜之子。

xianxia.concept: 斩妖人（参照）
xianxia.note: 成长靠「异变试炼」：每升一阶都要喝下更毒的药剂，存活率低。

entries.cost: 危险职业，寿命常短；被雇主怀疑与怪物有染。
entries.counter: 未知怪物、人类阴谋。
entries.visual: 镀银军刀与手弩、皮甲、装满克制材料的腰包。

details.力量源: 勇武 + 民俗知识；半吸血鬼者有血脉之力
details.成长: 功业 GR07、血脉觉醒 GR04

references.note: 银、冷铁、盐、花楸克制超自然

image.brief: A rugged adult monster hunter in worn oiled brown leather armor with a hooded short cape, a heavy sabre with a bright silver-plated edge at the hip, a compact crossbow slung across the back, a belt with pouches of salt, iron nails and dried rowan sprigs, a small flask and a string of garlic, weathered face with old claw scars, practical and grim.

subgroups.name: 黑暗与禁忌
subgroups.intro: 力量源是暗影、深渊或契约。不一定是反派，但一定被社会排斥。

entries.name: 死灵法师
entries.summary: 操纵死亡的施法者：唤起尸骨、与亡魂对话、吸取生命，终极目标常是成为巫妖。

xianxia.concept: 鬼修 / 尸修 / 驭尸人（参照）

entries.cost: 肉体逐渐亡灵化；处处被追杀。
entries.counter: 圣光、圣水、毁掉护命匣。
entries.visual: 黑灰长袍、骨饰、苍白皮肤、身旁鬼火与骷髅仆从。

references.work: 古希腊招魂术与中世纪 nigromancy

image.brief: A gaunt adult necromancer with ashen pale skin and dark-ringed eyes, in tattered layered black and bone-grey robes, a mantle decorated with small bird skulls and loose bones, a single raven skull hanging on a cord at the chest, holding a staff topped with a human skull wrapped in black wire, cold teal will-o-wisp lights hovering near the shoulders. No crosses, ankhs or religious pendants.

entries.name: 契约师
entries.summary: 与强大存在立约换取力量的人：力量随叫随到，但赞助者随时可以收回或要价。

xianxia.concept: 魔修 / 与魔头立约者（参照）
xianxia.note: 关键不是功法而是「合同」：剧情可以围绕条款与漏洞展开。

entries.cost: 契约条款（见契约魔法 DK01）。
entries.counter: 契约漏洞、赞助者的敌人、更高的仲裁者。
entries.visual: 身上的契约印记、一只不像动物的使魔、带有赞助者风格的服饰。

details.力量源: 深渊 / 妖精 / 亡灵 等赞助者
details.赞助者类型: 恶魔、妖精王、亡灵君主、古神

image.brief: A brooding adult warlock in a fitted black high-collared coat with ember-red lining, one forearm wrapped in bandages through which glowing orange contract-mark lines show, a burned edge of parchment tucked in the belt, a small black horned lizard-like familiar perched on the shoulder, faint red embers drifting around the hand.

entries.name: 女巫
entries.summary: 民间的魔法传承者：草药、诅咒、占卜、月相与使魔。被教会追猎，在乡野被需要。

xianxia.concept: 蛊师 / 旁门散修（参照）
xianxia.note: 欧美短剧与流行文化中最高频的魔法身份之一；常与血脉、家族诅咒、女巫会结合。

entries.cost: 被猎巫；诅咒反噬。
entries.counter: 审判官、冷铁、盐、被揭穿身份。
entries.visual: 深色层叠衣物、草药与小瓶、黑猫或乌鸦、银饰。

details.力量源: 巫术（自然 + 暗影混合）

image.brief: An enigmatic adult witch in layered dark plum and black skirts with a fitted laced bodice and a shawl, long dark hair with a few silver strands, many silver rings and a crescent moon pendant, a woven basket of herbs and small corked bottles on one arm, a black cat curled around her ankles, a knowing half-smile.

entries.name: 死亡骑士
entries.summary: 死后被唤回的骑士：保留武艺与意志，力量来自死亡与未竟的执念。

xianxia.concept: 尸将 / 鬼将（参照）
xianxia.note: 常由失恩的圣武士或战死的骑士转化，执念完成即可安息。

entries.cost: 永远寒冷、没有心跳；被执念驱使。
entries.counter: 圣光、完成或化解其执念。
entries.visual: 锈黑残破的旧板甲、沾着墓土与枯叶，头盔阴影中两点暗红余烬般的眼光，缺口的旧剑。

details.力量源: 暗影与死亡 + 勇武残余
details.来源: 背誓或含冤而死的骑士

references.note: death knight 已成通用类型词
避免「符文大剑 + 冰蓝发光眼 + 冰霜板甲」整套组合（魔兽死亡骑士强识别）

image.brief: A towering adult revenant knight risen from the grave in old rust-blackened battered plate armor with grave soil, roots and dead leaves clinging to it, a torn moth-eaten heraldic surcoat whose emblem has faded, the face hidden in the shadow of an open dented helm except for two dim ember-red pinpoints of light, gripping a notched ancient longsword, an air of grim sorrow rather than villainy.
